Hi Samir / team,

Thanks again for the productive call this morning. Attached are the MSA redlines (MSA_Redlines_v2.docx) and a fillable Order Form for your review. Before I prepare the DocuSign envelope, can you confirm:

- Who will be the executing signer(s) for the MSA (full legal entity signature)?
- Whether the Order Form needs to be signed in the same envelope or sent separately to Billing?
- Any required witness/notary or corporate attestations on your side?

Proposed routing (we can change based on your reply):
1) Authorized Signatory (company exec) — signs MSA
2) Procurement — acknowledgement / receive executed copy
3) Billing/Finance — receives executed Order Form (PDF) and triggers invoice/PO flow

DocuSign settings I plan to use: sequential signing, email verification + SMS step-up for the exec, reminders at 2 and 5 days, and automatic envelope audit log included. I can also include a fallback signer if the primary exec is unavailable.

If you can confirm the signer names and any legal constraints (e.g., CFO must countersign for amounts >$500k), I will lock the envelope and send it today.

Attachments: MSA_Redlines_v2.docx (redline), OrderForm_OliveTech_Fillable.pdf (fillable), Signer_Authority_Snapshot.xlsx (template for mapping)

Best,

Marissa —

Thanks for the docs and the clear routing proposal. Quick answers from our side:

- Primary signer for the MSA: Anita Mehra (CEO). Email: anita.m@olivetech.com
- Backup / countersign: Dinesh Patel (CFO) — only required if the total committed value exceeds $500k.
- For Order Forms under $250k, Leah Ortiz (Procurement Manager) is authorized to sign; if over that, CFO must countersign.
- No notary or in-person witness required for our contracts — standard e-signature is fine.

Please send the MSA + Order Form in a single envelope with sequential signing: Anita -> (conditional) Dinesh -> Leah (procurement receive only) -> Billing (receive copy). Include procurement@olivetech.com in the final recipients.

Janet (cc) — our legal will do a final pass; she expects to finish any minor edits today.

If you can add an explicit fallback (Dinesh) and add an alternate email for Anita (anita.m+contracts@olivetech.com) that would help.

Also, please include the final clean copy delivery instructions (filename convention + where it will be uploaded) so our Ops team can ingest the executed docs.

Appreciate it — send when ready.
